design.purpose: A drained outdoor planter for herbs or flowers, made from two weathered pine boards. Board-c is left unused for a future repair or matching planter.

steps.c: Place the 120 cm wide board flat for cutting.
Mark the base at 40 cm from one end.
Saw the 40 cm base from the wide board.
Place the 120 cm board flat for cutting.
Mark 40, 40, 16 and 16 cm in order.
Saw front, back and both 16 cm ends.
Place the 40 × 20 cm base flat.
Drill two 8 mm drainage holes through the base.
Stand the front side on the base front edge.
Stand the back side on the base back edge.
Fit the left end between the front and back.
Fit the right end between the front and back.
Drive {count} screws through the front into the left end
Drive {count} screws through the front into the right end
Drive {count} screws through the back into the left end
Drive {count} screws through the back into the right end
Drive {count} screws through the base into the front
Drive {count} screws through the base into the back
Drive {count} screws through the base into the left end
